scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The proof is elementary and complete; finite regression checks are supplementary and are not used to infer the infinite statement.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: The construction settles the closure question negatively but does not characterize all composition-preserving pairs. It shows that injectivity plus complete multiplicativity of the inner function is insufficient, not that surjectivity is necessary in every possible criterion.

title: Power-map counterexamples to composition closure of quasi-injective functions
